title: asarina geniculata
intro: Asarina geniculata, commonly known as False Purple Foxglove, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Asarina geniculata include its ability to reduce pain, lower body temperature, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
